descriptions.en: A Home Assistant custom integration that prints text, QR codes and images on Bluetooth thermal cat printers using Home Assistant Bluetooth and ESPHome proxies.
descriptions.ko: Home Assistant Bluetooth와 ESPHome 프록시를 통해 Bluetooth 감열식 고양이 프린터에 글자·QR 코드·이미지를 인쇄하는 커스텀 통합입니다.

categories_review.source: README Features and requirements and docs/user-guide.md: Bluetooth thermal printers produce physical text, QR codes and images; printers is the primary actual product category. Entity platforms do not determine this selection.
